headline: Sensex and Nifty recover as crude oil prices drop while IT stocks lead gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Moderation in global crude oil prices supported recovery in benchmark indices.
IT and media sectors showed strength and led market gains.
Pharma and healthcare sectors faced selling pressure, capping overall upside.
Analysts suggest fears regarding RBI rate hikes intensifying selloffs in bank stocks may be overdone.
whatHappening: Sensex recovered early losses to trade higher around 250 to 400 points up.
Nifty traded near the 22,700–22,750 mark during today's trading session.
Centre notified new CAFE norms tightening fuel-efficiency targets for passenger vehicles.
Axiscades Technologies surged 5% while Sun TV extended its monthly sprint of over 30%.
summary:
Indian equity indices Sensex and Nifty rebounded from early lower levels as moderating crude oil prices provided relief to the market.
IT and media stocks led gains while pharma and healthcare indices lagged behind.
Among individual stocks, Axiscades Technologies rose 5% following a stake purchase by Abakkus, while Sun TV continued its strong monthly rally.
